entities.summary: Carlos Adolfo Ott Buenafama is a Uruguayan-Canadian architect. He became famous when he won the international design competition in 1983 for the construction of the Opéra Bastille in Paris, which was inaugurated on July 14, 1989. Starting from an office in Toronto, Canada, Ott has since expanded his practice internationally. Ott's practice is headquartered in Montevideo, Uruguay, with offices in Dubai, Montreal, Shanghai and Toronto. Ott has designed buildings in Argentina, Canada, China, France, Germany, India, Paraguay, The Philippines, Singapore, Switzerland, United Arab Emirates, the United States, and Uruguay.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Carlos Ott's design of the Opéra Bastille had a significant impact on Parisian architecture and urban planning, contributing to the revitalization of the city's cultural scene. The building's completion marked a major milestone in the redevelopment of the Bastille Square area.
